notes.title: Update Notes for v1.1.0.
notes.notes:
Dear Players, 
Based on your initial feedback, this update contains the following improvements: 

Additions: 

 Improved level selection screen
 16 new levels (adding up to 36 levels)
 Level grading system


Changes:

 Improved design of the existing levels
 FROST item keeps the balls frozen for only one shot
 Reduced number of ICEPICK items per level
 Stability improvements 


NOTE:
Due to the newly implemented grading system and level selection, your progress from v.1.0.0 will be deleted.
